INSTAGRAM
Your friends will never tell you your CV is weak. Claude will.

Paste the job ad and your CV, then make Claude play the hiring manager for that exact role.
Ask for the 30-second scan: what stands out, what's missing, would you call me.
Then fix the bullets that do nothing. Never invent results.

Save this one for your next application, and follow for practical Claude tips you can use the same day.
